judgments.reason: The transcript and model never show a bid exceeding available coins nor an articulation that commission is applied before checking bid affordability. The model computes net coins after paying then receiving commission, but does not claim commission enables overbidding.

judgments.quote: letting me see if opposition is aggressive or conservative.
judgments.reason: The player explicitly uses waiting to observe a revealed committed rival bid (clerk shows P2's bid) and then commits a winning bid in the next round; the model articulates waiting to "see" opponents' aggression and acts on that observed committed bid.
No early settlement occurred; the game settled after all three lots were sold, matching the stated rule. The model did not observe or claim early settlement before unresolved lots remained.

The transcript and the model state that catalog items are not auction wins and the commission is awarded to auction winners; there is no evidence or articulation that catalog purchases receive the three-coin commission.
